Class McpToolException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpToolException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class McpToolException extends RuntimeException
Ends a tool call with an error result. The message is an NLS key that is translated into the language of the user; the extra fields are added to the error content as they are.
